recordSource: SELECT q.ID, q.LastName, q.FirstName, q.MiddleName, q.BirthDate, q.Notes, q.OccurrenceDate, Format(q.OccurrenceDate,"yyyymmdd") AS OccurrenceSortKey, BirthdayAgeText([q].[BirthDate],[q].[OccurrenceDate]) AS AgeText, Trim(q.LastName & " " & q.FirstName & IIf(Len(Nz(q.MiddleName,""))=0,""," " & q.MiddleName)) AS FullName FROM (SELECT tbBirthdays.ID, tbBirthdays.LastName, tbBirthdays.FirstName, tbBirthdays.MiddleName, tbBirthdays.BirthDate, tbBirthdays.Notes, BirthdayOccurrenceInWindow([BirthDate]) AS OccurrenceDate FROM tbBirthdays)  AS q WHERE q.OccurrenceDate Is Not Null ORDER BY Format(q.OccurrenceDate,"yyyymmdd"), [q].[LastName], [q].[FirstName], [q].[MiddleName];
